Write a brief for a paid AI pilot

Give bidders the same workflow, sample records and acceptance test. Their quotes will show what each team expects you to supply.

Worked example

Suppose a finance team wants help matching invoices to purchase orders. Pull a small set of closed invoices that includes split deliveries, duplicate invoices and missing order numbers. Have the person who processes invoices record the correct outcome for each. Hold some examples back for the acceptance test.

Worksheet
Field in the briefExample wording
Starting pointOur clerk opens the invoice and purchase order side by side. We can provide redacted copies and the clerk’s decision for each pair.
BoundaryThe pilot may suggest a match and explain discrepancies. The clerk approves every payment. The pilot has no bank access.
Acceptance testRun the held-back invoices with the clerk watching. Record correct matches, bad matches, escalations and review minutes separately.
Price comparisonQuote implementation, sample preparation, integration and recurring costs on separate lines. Identify who owns each task.

Decide whether to buy the rollout

A pilot that saves five minutes on a clean invoice can still add work on exceptions. Review one complete batch with the clerk. Use the time for the whole batch and the cost of fixing mistakes when you decide whether to continue.
